'''Hisao Egawa''' (Japanese: '''江川央生''' ''Egawa Hisao'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Egawa was born on September 13, 1962, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided his voice occasionally for {{aniseries|PTS}} during the {{aniseries|OS}}. He then returned during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing the [[Battle Club]] owners, all called [[Don George]], in [[Unova]]. Egawa is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
